Service	What you give it	Finished 60-sec output	Current price	My take

Scenes AI	Idea/script	Seedance scenes + voice + original music + animated captions + final assembly	Pay as you go; ~$3.62 for a standard 60-sec explainer	⭐ Best no-subscription option
Vidmonto	One prompt/idea	Agent plans shots → Seedance → voiceover + music + captions + effects → final video	Pro $23.20/mo annually; Lite also supports up to 60-sec output	Good for ads/brand videos
Zebracat	Idea or script	Routes scenes to Seedance, then automatically adds narration + music + captions and assembles up to 5 min	$39/mo monthly starting paid tier shown; Seedance 2.5 = 40 credits/clip	Best for longer/more polished production
1. Kineo — my first choice for exactly what you described

This is unusually close to your request. You enter one idea, and Kineo writes the script, breaks it into scenes, generates every scene with ByteDance Seedance 1.5 Pro, adds AI narration and captions, and gives you a finished 9:16 MP4. It explicitly prices Seedance at 25 credits for a 60-second video, and says there is no editing timeline required. 
Kineo

The free trial currently includes 30 credits, enough for one 60-second Seedance video; Starter is $9.90/month afterward. 
Kineo

One caveat: Kineo's Seedance page explicitly confirms voiceover and captions, but isn't as explicit about generated background music as some of the alternatives below.

Try Kineo Seedance

2. Swipeless — strongest evidence that it does the whole job

Swipeless is probably the most convincing option if narration + music + captions + Seedance animation are all mandatory.

There is an actual published project showing a 1:08 documentary where every scene was animated using Seedance, ElevenLabs provided narration, AI generated the music, captions were burned in, and Swipeless assembled/exported the entire film. The documented total cost was $4.19. 
Swipeless

It is essentially:

idea → script → visual direction → Seedance scenes → narration → music → captions → edit → finished MP4

You don't have to download the Seedance clips and assemble them elsewhere. Swipeless also publishes another 1:13 all-Seedance project and explicitly says its pipeline writes, voices, draws, animates and cuts the result together. 
Swipeless

Swipeless

See the $4.19 Seedance example

3. Scenes AI — best if you don't want another subscription

Scenes is pay-as-you-go, with $1 credit = $1 and no subscription/minimum. Its published estimate for a 60-second explainer with roughly eight scenes, AI voiceover, background music and captions is about $3.62 at Standard quality; Draft is about $2.06 and Premium about $16.07. 
Scenes AI

Importantly, its current engine list specifically includes Seedance 2.0 Fast, Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.5. 
Scenes AI

So this is a particularly interesting option if you want newer Seedance rather than Seedance 1.5.

Scenes AI pricing/generator

4. Vidmonto — good for a more "produced" 60-second video

Vidmonto's AI agent can start from a single text idea, plan the storyboard, generate shots using Seedance (or automatically mix it with Veo/Kling/etc.), and then handle voiceover, captions, music, color, effects and final editing. 
Vidmonto
+1

Its Pro tier is currently $23.20/month when billed annually, includes 3,000 monthly credits and supports up to 90-second output. Its Lite tier supports up to 60-second output. 
Vidmonto

I'd put this above Kineo for things like a product commercial or cinematic brand piece, but below Kineo for rapidly making straightforward Shorts.

Vidmonto

Vidmonto pricing

5. Zebracat — best when you want the system to decide where Seedance is worth using

Zebracat treats Seedance as part of a full production pipeline. Give it a script or idea and it can route appropriate scenes to Seedance 2.5, then deliver a completed video with voiceover, word-synced captions and music. Finished projects can run up to five minutes, so 60 seconds isn't a problem. 
Zebracat

The current paid pricing page shows Cat Mode at $39/month, with 15 videos/month and credits for models including Seedance; higher tiers provide substantially more generative credits. 
Zebracat

An interesting difference is that Zebracat doesn't insist on using Seedance for every shot. Its agent can use Seedance where continuity matters and cheaper/better-suited models elsewhere. 
Zebracat

Zebracat Seedance 2.5

Zebracat pricing

For your exact requirement, I'd start with Kineo or Swipeless. Kineo is the simplest “type an idea → get a 60-second Seedance Short” workflow. Swipeless is the better bet if you specifically want narration + proper background music + captions + fully generated Seedance visuals with essentially no manual assembly. If you want Seedance 2.x specifically, rather than 1.5, I'd try Scenes AI first.
